Hi Professor — happy to. I went through next week and I have to be straight with you: there is no free hour anywhere Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00. My days are back-to-back, and the only open windows I have are 30 minutes each:

- **Mon** 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- **Tue** 15:00–15:30
- **Wed** 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30
- **Thu** — nothing free
- **Fri** — nothing free

So a one-hour staff meeting won't fit unless something moves. Options I can see:

1. Take one of the 30-minute windows and keep the meeting to half an hour.
2. You tell me which hour you'd like, and I'll try to shift the conflicting commitment (grading, focus blocks and study groups are the easiest to move; lectures, office hours and quiz sections are not).
3. Ask the department office whether the official schedule has any slack that week.

Which would you like? If you name a preferred day and time, I'll check with whoever I'd be displacing before I confirm.

Hi Prof. Alvarez — here's my availability for next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00).

Honestly, I don't have a **full free hour** anywhere next week — almost every block is already taken by office hours, quiz sections, lectures, grading, study/reading groups and meetings. What I do have:

- **Monday:** 10:00–10:30, 14:00–14:30
- **Tuesday:** 15:00–15:30
- **Wednesday:** 10:00–10:30, 13:00–13:30
- **Thursday:** nothing free
- **Friday:** nothing free

So a 30-minute slot would fit, most comfortably Monday 10:00–10:30 or Wednesday 13:00–13:30. If the meeting really needs the full hour, tell me which block to give up (I could move "Focus: CSE444 project" on Monday 13:30–14:00 alongside the 14:00–14:30 gap, which together would make 13:30–14:30) — or I can shift lunch on Tuesday or Wednesday.

Which would you like?

Hi Prof. Alvarez — here is my availability for next week, Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00.

Honestly, I have no free hour in that window: my week is fully packed except for half-hour gaps.

- Monday: free 14:00–14:30 only (before that: 09:00–10:00 research group, 10:00–11:30 reading group, 11:30–12:30 lunch, 12:30–13:20 CSE452 focus, 13:20–14:00 advisor 1:1; after: 14:30–15:20 study group, 15:20–17:00 seminar)
- Tuesday: free 11:00–11:30 and 15:00–15:30
- Wednesday: free 10:00–10:30 and 13:00–13:30
- Thursday: no gaps at all (09:00–17:00 fully booked)

Happy to also check with the department office whether anything in my week is out of date.

Hi Prof. Alvarez — here is my availability for next week (Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00), for a meeting of about an hour:

**No free hour, I'm afraid.** My week is booked solid: every day is filled end to end with lectures, office hours, quiz sections, grading, reading groups, study groups, seminars and my focus blocks, and the only gaps are 30 minutes:

- **Mon** 10:00–10:30
- **Tue** 11:00–11:30, 15:00–15:30
- **Wed** 10:00–10:30

Thu and Fri have no gap at all (Thu: 15:10–17:00 Advisor 1:1; Fri: 15:50–17:00 CSE444 lecture).

Two options: (1) if a 30-minute staff meeting is enough, Tuesday 15:00–15:30 is my cleanest slot; (2) if it needs the full hour, tell me which commitment to move or drop and I'll rearrange and log it. I'd also suggest Tuesday or Wednesday mid-morning, since that's when most of the TA team is free between classes.

Just say the word and I'll book it.
